publish-a11y-disclosure.title: 无障碍 Play 审核 disclosure 强化（onboarding copy + strings.xml）
publish-a11y-disclosure.description:
现状：onboarding 已有 WizardStep.Accessibility 这一步（OnboardingSteps.kt 中 permissionStepCopy），用户主动点 "Open Accessibility Settings" 跳转系统设置启用——这就是 affirmative consent 流程。但当前 copy 对 Play 审核而言不够，缺三件 Play 政策必查的内容：(a) 屏幕内容会发给 LLM 提供商；(b) 隐私政策链接；(c) 不在后台运行的明确说明。strings.xml 里 accessibility_service_description 也太简单（这是 Android 系统 Settings 里看服务时展开的描述，Play 审核也看）。

要做的事（窄）：
1. 重写 OnboardingSteps.kt 中 WizardStep.Accessibility 的 description（保留同样视觉布局，只扩 copy），加入 LLM 数据流向 / 隐私政策链接 / not-in-background 保证。
2. 重写 strings.xml 中 accessibility_service_description 为 200+ 字符详细版（覆盖：服务做什么 / 何时激活 / 何时不激活 / 用户控制权）。

不做：不新增独立 consent dialog，不动 onboarding 结构。Affirmative consent 由用户主动点 Open Accessibility Settings 提供，符合 Play 政策（Voice Access 同模式）。

详见 projects/active/1_publish/3_privacy_claude.md, projects/active/1_publish/5_play_store_claude.md。
acceptCriteria: accessibility_service_description 字符串 > 200 字符且覆盖：服务做什么 / 何时激活 / 用户控制权
OnboardingSteps WizardStep.Accessibility description 提到 LLM 数据流向 + 隐私政策链接 + not-in-background 保证
UI 视觉无明显断行/溢出
publish-a11y-disclosure.note: Done at 334d4390 (3 commits: c47a977d expand, 08a5b1e0 tighten+collapsible, 334d4390 drop placeholder URL). Worker added collapsible extendedDescription field to onboarding step (better UX than long always-shown copy). Privacy policy URL deferred to publish-privacy-policy — wiring real URL into OnboardingSteps.kt extendedDescription is part of that task.

publish-storage-permissions-cleanup.title: 移除 READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE（targetSdk 36 下已无效）

vd-session-platform-proxy.title: Use VD session platform proxy
vd-session-platform-proxy.description: Make VD sessions use a lightweight AndroidPlatform proxy that holds session-scoped policy/config and delegates runtime work through a lease. In VD mode, platform.stop() releases only the session lease.
acceptCriteria: VD mode uses VirtualDisplaySessionPlatform or equivalent proxy implementing AndroidPlatform
SessionServices.cleanup() still calls platform.stop(), and in VD mode that path releases a session lease without directly releasing VD resources

vd-platform-factory-wiring.title: Wire VD runtime through platform factory
vd-platform-factory-wiring.description: Change VD platform creation so PlatformFactory obtains a session platform from the runtime manager while preserving Shizuku availability/permission fallback to AccessibilityPlatform.
acceptCriteria: PlatformFactory no longer constructs raw VirtualDisplayPlatform directly for session ownership
Shizuku unavailable/permission-missing fallback to AccessibilityPlatform remains covered by tests or existing behavior checks

vd-viewer-runtime-bridge.title: Move VD viewer bridge to runtime manager
vd-viewer-runtime-bridge.description: Route viewer attach/detach/touch through the runtime manager instead of casting the active session platform to VirtualDisplayPlatform.
acceptCriteria: AgentServiceViewerBridge uses the runtime manager API for viewer visible/hidden/touch handling
No production code path casts session?.getServices()?.platform as? VirtualDisplayPlatform for viewer operations

rg -n "as\? .*VirtualDisplayPlatform|switchToLivePreview|switchToImageReader" app/src/main/kotlin/ai/closepaw/app app/src/main/kotlin/ai/closepaw/ui/viewer exits 0 with only allowed runtime-manager usages

vd-runtime-idle-policy.title: Implement VD runtime idle retention policy
vd-runtime-idle-policy.description: When the last VD session ends, keep the runtime in IdleRetained and release it only on explicit stop, app/service teardown, runtime failure, or a configured idle timeout.
acceptCriteria: Last VD session cleanup transitions runtime to IdleRetained instead of releasing the VD immediately
Explicit stop, lifecycle teardown, runtime failure, and idle timeout release the VD through one centralized runtime stop path
A unit or QA test covers last-session cleanup retaining VD and explicit stop releasing it

vd-runtime-service-wrapper.title: Optional same-process VD runtime service wrapper
vd-runtime-service-wrapper.description: Wrap the stabilized runtime manager in an app-internal started+bound Android service using a same-process local binder. Do not introduce AIDL, an independent APK, or a separate process in this phase.
acceptCriteria: Manifest declares an app-internal same-process VirtualDisplayRuntimeService or equivalent only if the service wrapper is approved
The service exposes the same runtime API through a local binder without AIDL or a separate process

app-security.description: Add a per-app security policy sub-page to Settings: list every installed app, show its effective tier (Always / Ask / Reject), and let the user change it. See design doc for the canonical PolicyEngine.check ordering, the app-scoped AppClassifierHolder, and the Mutex-serialized setOverride contract.

app-security-classifier-overrides.title: AppClassifier overrides + PolicyEngine refactor
app-security-classifier-overrides.description: Make AppClassifier the single writer for user overrides: expose userOverrides: StateFlow<Map<String, AppTier>>, add setOverride(pkg, tier): SetOverrideResult using updateAndGet for in-memory CAS plus Mutex.withLock around the full update+persist sequence (prevents on-disk skew). Bundled-BLOCKED is the safety floor — setOverride refuses non-BLOCKED overrides at write time. Selecting the chip that matches the bundled tier auto-removes the override entry. Introduce AppClassifierHolder (mirrors AuthStoreHolder / ModelCatalogRepositoryHolder) so the same instance is shared across MainActivity, settings UI, capsule, AgentSession.create:71, AgentSession.reload:150, and SessionServices.create (which becomes non-nullable on appClassifier). PolicyEngine drops the persistent allow-list code path; the new check() ordering is the 6-step canonical sequence: (1) non-screen-changing → Allow, (2) escape → Allow, (3) effective tier = min(currentTier, destTier) == BLOCKED → Deny, (4) BrowserScript → its own gate, (5) mode != ALWAYS_ASK && isSessionAllowed(subject) → Allow, (6) mode dispatch on effective tier. session allow-list (allowPackageForSession) stays on PolicyEngine. ApprovalScope.ALWAYS becomes scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) { classifier.setOverride(pkg, NORMAL) }. Also fix MainActivity.hasLegacyUsageEvidence() (line ~932) to read loadUserAppOverrides() instead of removed loadPersistentAllowList().
acceptCriteria: AppClassifier.userOverrides is StateFlow<Map<String, AppTier>> backed by immutable maps
setOverride is suspend, uses Mutex.withLock around updateAndGet + persistence callback
setOverride returns RefusedBlocked for non-BLOCKED tier on bundled-BLOCKED package (no emission, no persist)
setOverride auto-removes the entry when tier matches bundled default
AppClassifierHolder.get(context) returns the single shared instance
SessionServices.create takes non-nullable appClassifier; nullable fallback removed
AgentSession.create and AgentSession.reload call AppClassifierHolder.get(...) (no local AppClassifier.fromAssets)
PolicyEngine.check follows the 6-step canonical ordering; session allow-list (allowPackageForSession) retained
PolicyEngine no longer references persistentAllowedPackages / allowPackagePersistent / isUserAllowed / onPersistentAllowListChanged / initialPersistentAllowList
ApprovalScope.ALWAYS in AgentSession dispatches via classifier.setOverride (Dispatchers.IO)

./gradlew test passes including: bundled-BLOCKED write-time refusal, remove-on-match, concurrent setOverride preserves final persisted snapshot (same pkg + different pkgs), open_app to bundled-BLOCKED dest → Deny, open_app to CAUTIOUS dest under SMART → AskUser, user-NORMAL on chrome under ALWAYS_ASK → AskUser, browser_script under SMART → AskUser, session-allowed pkg under SMART → Allow, session-allowed pkg under ALWAYS_ASK → AskUser

Rewrite Perception Mode as a vertical radio list with outcome-oriented copy (Screen Transcript / Screen Image / Transcript + Image). display-perception-vd-gate.title: VirtualDisplayToggleGate + tests
display-perception-vd-gate.description: New VirtualDisplayToggleGate.kt mirroring BrowserScriptToggleGate one-for-one. Sealed VirtualDisplayToggleError (ShizukuUnavailable, ShizukuPermissionDenied) + .message(). Suspend gateVirtualDisplayEnable() helper with injectable lambdas (isShizukuAvailable / hasShizukuPermission / requestShizukuPermission). VirtualDisplayToggleGate class with setEnabled / clearError / pending / error + rememberVirtualDisplayToggleGate Compose factory. Top-of-file comment documents the asymmetry vs browser_script gate: NO I/O preflight (no CommandLineWriter equivalent) — Ready means preference accepted + Shizuku currently ready, not platform.start() guaranteed. Stale-error guard lives in DisplaySection (LaunchedEffect on persistedMode), NOT in the gate — keeps gate dispatcher-agnostic and StateFlow-free.

display-perception-mapper.title: VirtualDisplayStatusMapper + 12-row tests
display-perception-mapper.description: Pure mapper virtualDisplayCardState(persistedMode, effectiveMode, shizukuStatus, gatePending, gateError): VirtualDisplayCardState. Output struct (NOT Pair): { status: ToolStatusUi, switchChecked: Boolean, switchEnabled: Boolean, rowAction: VirtualDisplayRowAction? }. Companion VirtualDisplayRowAction sealed interface: RetryEnable (re-attempt OFF→ON via gate.clearError+setEnabled(true)) and RequestPermission (bypass gate, call Shizuku directly). First-match-wins lookup over the 12-row table in the design. Rows 2-3 (gate errors) require persistedMode == ACCESSIBILITY in their conditions. Row 10 copy is `Current session is configured for a virtual display` — deliberately weaker than `runs on` because effectiveMode==VD only proves selection, not start() success. No Compose deps in mapper or tests.

display-perception-section.title: DisplaySection composable + ToolSettingsCard switchModifier
display-perception-section.description: New DisplaySection.kt replaces DisplayModeSection.kt. Hosts one ToolSettingsCard driven by virtualDisplayCardState. Reuses ShizukuClient + rememberShizukuStatus. Holds UI-local permissionRequestPending: MutableState<Boolean> guard for RequestPermission row action — when pending, composable passes onRowClick = null (NOT a no-op lambda) so card surface goes non-interactive with correct TalkBack semantics. LaunchedEffect(persistedMode) { if (persistedMode == VIRTUAL_DISPLAY) gate.clearError() } guards against deep-link race. Card title `Virtual Display`. Section title `Display Mode`. Adds display-mode-switch testTag on the Switch via the new switchModifier parameter (small additive change to ToolSettingsCard: switchModifier: Modifier = Modifier — existing Termux/BrowserScript callers default to no-op, unaffected). Delete old DisplayModeSection.kt and its private composables (ModeOption, EffectiveModeRow, ShizukuStatusRow).

display-perception-move.title: Move Display Mode section from Permissions to Agent Behavior
display-perception-move.description: AgentBehaviorSettingsPage gains platformMode / effectivePlatformMode / onPlatformModeChange parameters and renders DisplaySection(...) between PerceptionModeSelector and ToolsSection. display-perception-homepage.title: SettingsHomePage subtitles: drop perms chip, expand agent-behavior chip

Display chip mapping (5 cases): (A11y, ∈{null,A11y}) → no chip · (A11y, VD) → ` · VD (this session)` · (VD, VD) → ` · VD` · (VD, A11y) → ` · VD (next session)` · (VD, null) → ` · VD`. display-perception-perception.title: Perception Mode: vertical radio list + new copy
display-perception-perception.description: PerceptionModeSelector rewritten: vertical radio list inside Column.selectableGroup() with title + subtitle per row + a `Recommended` chip on `Screen Transcript` (chip on a line below the label to avoid narrow-screen overflow). Labels EXACTLY: `Screen Transcript` / `Screen Image` / `Transcript + Image`. Subtitles EXACTLY: (Transcript) `Reads on-screen text and structure. Fastest, lowest cost, and works for most apps.` (Image) `Looks at screenshots only. Slower and higher cost; use for maps, canvas, games, or apps that hide their structure.` (Hybrid) `Combines both. Most reliable for tricky apps; slowest and highest cost.` Each row uses Modifier.selectable(role = Role.RadioButton) with full row as tap target. Underlying value IDs unchanged (`accessibility_only` / `screenshot_only` / `hybrid`). SettingsHomePage chip mapping: hybrid → `Transcript + Image`, screenshot_only → `Image`, default → `Transcript`.
